changes.title: Correct stale statistics after history replacement
changes.text: Check raw-log contents before reusing cached rows, even when the file name, size and timestamp are unchanged.

changes.title: Recover older row caches safely
changes.text: Bind derived caches to their source and rebuild older caches without changing raw history or saves.

changes.title: Reuse source-check workspace
changes.text: Reuse one small hashing buffer across a statistics load instead of allocating one for every log.

changes.title: Verify source replacement and cache compatibility
changes.text: Test changed equal-sized logs, unchanged caches, older cache rebuilding and incorrect source fingerprints.

changes.title: Retain complete verification records
changes.text: Record the preceding verified build and the cache correction's reproduction, tests, compatibility and remaining limits.

commentary: I fixed stale cached rows after an equal-sized history replacement. Raw player history is preserved; old optional caches rebuild automatically.
